rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Short, steep kerb on a narrow street with homes about 10 m away.
reasons: Dwellings about 10 m at both ends

drivers.seclusion: Apartments and detached houses about 10 m away on both sides of the short stretch; no buffer.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with angle-parking bays beside it; room for a van is tight on only 15 m of kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near the Taringa station.
drivers.convention: Angle parking and some cars park here, but no overnight convention seen.

flags: No Parking Mon-Fri 7am-6pm signs on this kerb
sun_shade: Trees shade the western kerb; open to the afternoon sun from the west.
